"""
Service layer for proxy functionality.

This module provides a stable interface between URL routing and view logic,
reducing coupling between Django layers (AT39 - Reduced Coupling).
"""
from proxy.views import proxy_view as _proxy_view


def get_proxy_url_pattern():
    """
    Return the URL pattern tuple for proxy routing.
    
    Enables URL configuration to depend on a stable interface rather than
    concrete view functions, supporting decoupling and easier testing.
    """
    return r'^proxy/(?P<url>.*)$', _proxy_view
